automatic_scope: synthetic RydeX on-demand fixtures with complete evidence

rules.statement: On-demand rider cancellations within three minutes of matching are not chargeable under the general policy.
The published rider no-show amount is 661 cents and the waiting condition is strictly more than 180 seconds after I'm Here at pickup.
The published completed-trip waiting charge is 500 cents after more than 180 seconds.
GPS must support arrival at the pickup location; no public numerical tolerance is asserted.
No-show guidance instructs attempting in-app chat or call without a published minimum count or duration.
Eligible cancellation-waiver requests have a 30-day window and use a 661-cent wallet voucher remedy.
General quoted fares are fixed except RydeTAXI; route preference should be agreed and longer distance alone does not establish overcharge.
RydeX ERP is additional and should correspond to actual gantries passed.
Accepted in-app destination changes can change fare and incur a separate 300-cent add/edit fee.

limitations: Advanced-trip cases with an unresolved early-arrival clock require human review.
The driver payout and rider charge are different quantities.
Conflicting public waiting-fee descriptions are not silently reconciled.
Public rules are isolated from organizer and demo interpretations.
